events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Augustus becomes emperor; he settles veterans at Philippi (42 and 31 BC).
Philippi is a Roman colony; Nero becomes emperor in AD 54.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from prison, about AD 60 to 62 (debated)

teaser.title: Paul founds the church
teaser.text: Paul reaches Philippi on his second journey, about AD 49 to 50 (Acts 16).

teaser.title: Philippians is written
teaser.text: Paul is a prisoner, probably in Rome, about AD 60 to 62.

teaser.title: Epaphroditus carries it
teaser.text: Epaphroditus, who brought the Philippians' gift, returns with the letter (2:25-30).
